title: FlexLine Back-Billed Draw Fee on Frequently Drawn Lines
content:
**Ruling — FlexLine Personal Lines of Credit.** The way a back-billed draw fee is figured follows how often the line is drawn and the size of the draw: on a line with 6 or more draws posted in the last 12 months, a draw below 500.00 USD is charged the percent on the part of the draw above 100.00 USD only; on such a line, a draw of 500.00 USD or more is charged the full percent on the first 500.00 USD and half the percent on the rest; on a line with fewer than 6 draws in the last 12 months the percent is charged on the whole draw.

The percent is the percent applied to the back-billed fee; the draw is the draw being billed. The draws counted are the draw entries on the line dated after the same day of the month 12 months before the booking date. The fee so figured is rounded to the cent, an exact half cent going to the even cent.

| Draws in the last 12 months | Draw | Charged |
|---|---|---|
| 6 or more | below 500.00 | the percent on the part above 100.00 |
| 6 or more | 500.00 or more | the full percent on the first 500.00, half the percent on the rest |
| fewer than 6 | any | the percent on the whole draw |

## Hypothetical figures (a 2.0% percent)

- 7 draws in the window, draw 400.00: 2.0% of 300.00 is 6.00.
- 7 draws in the window, draw 2300.00: 2.0% of 500.00 is 10.00, plus 1.0% of 1800.00 is 18.00, together 28.00.
- 5 draws in the window, draw 2300.00: 2.0% of 2300.00 is 46.00.
